messages:
mike: Heads-up — I want to do a per-customer toggle rollout for the new inference-cost-saver feature. This will be contract-gated (only specific enterprise contracts). Asking for a quick sync on scope + guardrails.

jess: timeline? do we have pilot customers lined up? :eyes:

mike: Targeting 2 pilots (acct_5412, acct_8841) first week of next sprint. Canary plan: enable for those 2 customers only, then 20% of enterprise traffic, then full enterprise.

ben: +1 on the staged approach. A couple notes: 1) prefer toggles to be per-customer allowlist (no percent-rollout at first for pilots), 2) require auto-fallback to the older model on error, 3) add metric hooks for error-rate and cost-per-token.

carla: QA needs the exact flag key and the customer ids so we can add tests to our contract fixtures. Also need example API calls to validate behavior in staging.

mike: Flag config draft (will store in feature-flags repo):

```yaml
flag_key: "inference_cost_saver_v1"
strategy: "per_customer"
allowlist: ["acct_5412", "acct_8841"]
fallback_behavior: "fallback_model_small"
monitoring: ["token_cost.avg", "error_rate.5m", "latency.p95"]
owner: "mike"
```

carla: perfect, I'll add those customers to staging allowlist and wire tests. QA will run a smoke that asserts the model selection and a fallback on simulated failure.

qa-liz: Planning tests: 1) request from allowed customer -> expect cost_saver model, 2) request from non-allowed enterprise -> expect default model, 3) simulate infra error -> expect fallback_model_small and a 503 metric emitted.

mike: Deployment plan:
- Stage (next deploy) enable per-customer flag for pilots in staging -> run smoke tests.
- Prod canary: enable for acct_5412 + acct_8841 in prod (explicit allowlist) for 24h. Monitor metrics and roll back if error_rate > 1% or latency p95 increases > 30%.
- If stable, expand to 20% enterprise traffic with progressive ramp.

ben: Who flips the prod canary and during what window? Also we should have a preflight checklist.

mike: I can flip the prod canary but want a second pair of eyes. Propose Thursday 10:00 PST — minimal traffic period for those customers. Preflight checklist:
- confirm contract entitlements (legal verified)
- QA signoff on staging smoke
- Alerting configured (slo + cost drift alert)
- Runbook ready for rollback

carla: Added checklist to the ticket (#INV-4321). I've pinged finance to confirm billing implications.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary/2026-03-12-0930 by mike -> status: queued

oncall-sre: I'll be on watch during the canary window and will escalate if any infra errors spike. Please post the exact monitor links once set. :+1:

mike: Thanks — monitors: https://console.redwood/metrics/token_cost, https://console.redwood/alerts/error_rate. I've granted carla/qa-liz access.

jess: quick code-review ping: @ben can you review the feature-flags PR? Small change to check contract entitlements in gating logic.

ben: Will review in next hour. If anything risky, I'll call it out here.

carla: One more guardrail suggestion: add a hard kill switch that disables cost-saver for all enterprise accounts if cost_per_token goes above expected by 50% in a 15m window. That should be in runbook as an automated step too.

mike: Good call — adding auto-disable rule.

qa-liz: After canary, QA will run a regression against our prompt-sets to ensure outputs remain within quality thresholds. We'll post results in this thread.

mike: Awesome. If everyone agrees, I'll open the PR and schedule the canary for Thu 10:00 PST. Everyone ok with that?

jess: ok from my side.

ben: ok. :shipit:

carla: ok. I'll be around for the flip and to watch the QA dashboards.

mike: Great — thanks team. I'll post the PR link and drop the runbook here when ready.

(edited)
